create_swimmer_environment: create a swimmer environment with configurable number of links and simulation parameters
build_swimmer_model: build an MJCF swimmer model XML with n bodies, joints, motors, and sensors
run_swimmer_reset: run the swimmer environment reset with random initial qpos and target position
run_swimmer_step: run the swimmer environment step with action input and return updated state
test_swimmer_reward: test the swimmer reward function based on nose-to-target distance with long_tail sigmoid
